about: Band cut-offs by prose length for BBBScorer 0.9.0 (tools/build_length_bands.mjs): Original-ish below the 94th percentile of 2023 cards (mostly human) of that length, Common from the 98th.
source: PROVISIONAL: a 23.5k-card sample of 2023 cards scored with the 0.9.0 rules (dev experiment), not a full scoring run. Rebuild with node tools/build_length_bands.mjs after the 0.9.0 rescore.
